note: The owner's rules in force for the XAUUSD advisory system, each with its source. Changed only by a reviewed PR in this repository.

rules.rule: Advisory only: no broker integration, no orders, no automatic execution and no position size.
Reports to the platform kernel never carry price levels (entry, stop, target, zones, key levels).

In the Live War Room 15m, BUY needs a confirmed buy signal (the H1 Prophet R38 confirmation, or a verified 5m Prophet R38 confirmation candle) and SELL a confirmed sell; without it the stance is WAIT. The H1 decision and the 1H, 4H and D1 rooms follow the quorum instead (h1_quorum).
rules.source: xauusd src/war-room.mjs CONFIRMATION_RULE; owner decisions 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-09

rules.rule: The H1 decision is the quorum of the 1H War Room, independent of the TradingView webhooks, of parity approval and of any single indicator signal: BUY or SELL only when the moderator concluded it and more than the quorum share (0.5 by default) of the weight of the agents who spoke holds the matching bias; otherwise WAIT. Indicator signals are the agents' arguments, never gates or vetoes. Prices come from the Key Level Agent's zones; without a valid entry, stop and target the decision is WAIT.
rules.source: xauusd docs/SSOT.md, The H1 decision is the room's quorum; owner decision 2026-11-09

rules.rule: Every opening states its action and its bias (BULLISH, BEARISH or NEUTRAL): the direction its own data leans, even when the action is WAIT.
rules.source: xauusd docs/SSOT.md, Bias beside the action

rules.rule: A BUY or SELL conclusion needs at least one agent holding that stance; a BULLISH or BEARISH bias needs at least one agent holding it.

Agents never mention calibration, parity or verification in their text; readers see each agent's calibration status once, next to its name. In the Live War Room 15m an agent with no calibrated statement speaks at confidence 0.4 or lower; the 1H, 4H and D1 rooms have no such cap (owner decision 2026-11-09).
Each HUD or indicator agent analyses only the data its own HUD or indicator produces.
Without a usable closed candle, or without a quorum, the H1 decision is WAIT, never a guess.
rules.source: xauusd docs/SSOT.md, H1 chain; owner decision 2026-11-09

rules.rule: Local engine trust comes only from the parity registry (24 consecutive matching candles); nothing is marked verified by hand, and the Pine sources and hashed engines are never edited.

No change to an engine parameter, a prompt or a knowledge item is promoted automatically: candidates run in shadow, are judged by outcome scoring with a significance test, and the owner approves a separate promotion PR. The one exception is the H1 quorum weighting (weighting_by_approval).

The H1 quorum weighting (each agent's own weight and the quorum share) is tuned by Aether over a reviewed grid: the calibrator proposes a point that xauusd's replay rates better on discovery and holdout, a person approves it in the Console, and xauusd activates it only while its replay still agrees; a point that does worse in reverse shadow is rolled back automatically.
rules.source: xauusd docs/SSOT.md, The H1 quorum weighting; owner decisions 2026-11-09

rules.rule: Learned knowledge is labelled as learned, cites its evidence, and never redefines a field or a rule of the canon.
Calls to the platform kernel use RPC Service Bindings without shared secrets; reports are info or warning, never critical; a denial is final (no retry, no switching agent ids).
